items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Plus, our little job we had in town every night, see, when we were playing over at Fatty's.

ctx.x: And who else came and sat in?

Well, that was about the only ones that were there at the time. You see, I don't know, I guess it's sort of traditional. This house of jazz, any time a famous musician or a celebrity passes through, they should stop in this place and sign the book. So, it just so happens that we were in there when these people, Pettiford and Ella came through. And, you know, being in a place like that, you just get to see all the celebrities, all the greats and whatnot. Incidentally, this fellow that ran the place, his name was…
You don't know how to spell that name, huh?
